headline: Approved policy on pregnancy and childbirth accommodations, plus updates to family leave and district philosophy policies.
summary: The meeting approved three policy updates, including a policy on accommodations for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions. It also approved three personnel nominations for the 2026-2027 school year. Facility master plan dates were discussed: a Harriman presentation on October 21, 2026 and a public hearing on October 28, 2026.
decisions: Approved policy AD, Philosophy of the School District, 7-0.
Approved Policy GBAM on accommodation of pregnancy, childbirth, pediatric infant care and other related conditions, 7-0.
Approved Policy GCCBC, Family and Medical Leave Act, 7-0.
Approved the October 13, 2026 personnel recommendations (three nominations), 7-0.

1 
  
BOARD OF EDUCATION 
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026 
NHS NORTH BOARD ROOM 
 
A meeting of the Board of Education was held at NHS North on Tuesday, October 13, 2026.  Ms. Bishop 
called the meeting to order at 6:04 pm and asked Ms. Raymond to read the opening statement and Mr. 
Johnson to lead the Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
Present: Ms. Giglio, Ms. Prinn (6:24 pm arrival), Mr. Johnson, Ms. Raymond, Ms. Lewis, Mr. Salvi, Ms. 
Lamphier, and Ms. Bishop 
 
Also Present:  Dr. Andrade, Dr. Scarpati, Mr. O’Rourke 
Also Present:  Members of the Public, Channel 99 Videographer 
  
CONSENT AGENDA 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Raymond, to approve the Consent Agenda.  Motion passes 7-0. 
 
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT AGENDA 
 
COMMUNICATIONS OUTSIDE THE CONSENT AGENDA 
 
PUBLIC QUESTION/COMMENT PERIOD LIMITED TO ITEMS ON THIS AGENDA 
None 
 
SUPERINTENDENT’S COMMENTS 
• District leadership work includes developing a portrait of a Nashua leader, exploring participation in 
the 603 Literacy Initiative, and continuing responsible AI implementation. 
• The superintendent will review Youth Risk Behavior Survey results from both high schools with their 
leadership teams and the Greater Nashville Prevention Coalition. 
• Facility master plan milestones discussed: Harriman presentation on October 21, 2026, public hearing 
on October 28, 2026 and a board vote date (to be determined). 
 
BOARD RESPONSE TO SUPERINTENDENT’S COMMENTS 
• Ms. Lamphier wanted the public to know that the board doesn’t know about issue unless you reach 
out to them. 
• Ms. Raymond mentioned that she could not find the survey on our website.   Dr. Andrade said he 
would check on that and make sure it was available for everyone. 
 
STUDENT REPRESENTATIVE COMMENTS 
 
COMMITTEE ON BUDGET 
 
COMMITTEE ON FINANCE AND OPERATIONS 
 
COMMITTEE ON POLICY 
 
• Policy AD was updated to align the district’s philosophy, mission, and core values with the strategic 
plan and PRIDE practices. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to approve policy AD – Philosophy of the School District.  
Motion passes 7-0.
BOARD OF EDUCATION MEETING  October 13, 2026 
 
 
2 
• With the adoption of policy GBAM, pregnancy, childbirth, pediatric infant care, and related-condition 
protections will be accessible under district policy. Members discussed overlapping contract language 
and keeping policies current with state law. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to approve Policy GBAM – Accommodation of Pregnancy, 
Childbirth, Pediatric Infant Care and Other Related Conditions.  Motion passes 7-0. 
 
• Policy GCCBC, Family and Medical Leave Act, was reviewed with no substantive revisions, and 
updated with a 2026 review-date. 
 
Ms. Raymond moved, seconded by Mr. Johnson, to approve Policy GCCBC – Family and Medical Leave Act.  
Motion passes 7-0. 
 
The October policy meeting is scheduled for October 20, including a discussion of special education policy 
recommendations from Dr. Vicente, Director of Special Education. 
 
COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES  
 
UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
 
NEW BUSINESS 
 
• Personnel Recommendations:  Administration explained that positions hired after October 1 are 
designated continuing substitute positions under the contract; these positions will be reposted in 
spring, and service credit will count as a full year. 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Lewis, to approve the October 13, 2026 Personnel Recommendations.  
Motion passes 7-0.

Conversations were held on the scheduling of all meetings regarding the Facility Master Plan. 
 
Ms. Giglio moved, seconded by Ms. Prinn, to adjourn.  So voted at 6:29 pm.
